faqs.question: Do you handle patient data securely?
faqs.answer: We only collect what the booking needs, use encrypted connections, and keep clinical records out of the website entirely. Your clinical notes stay in your practice software.

faqs.answer: Most clinics are on our Growth plan at $399/month, which covers the website, booking, reminders, hosting and updates. There is no upfront build fee and no long contract.
